evals.prompt: Напиши тести для сторінки оформлення Зеленої картки.
evals.expected_output: Pauses before creating plans or code to ask 1-2 focused multiple-choice questions clarifying domain (Finance vs Minfin), layer (UI vs API), and target environment.
expectations: Identifies critical ambiguity in product platform (finance.ua vs minfin.ua), test layer (UI E2E vs iBPM API), and scope
Asks at most 1-2 concise multiple-choice questions with a (Recommended) default option before generating code
Does not ask confirmation questions for MCP tool execution (respects 100% MCP Auto-Approval policy)

evals.prompt: Додай перевірку пільговиків у розрахунок ОСЦПВ.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies whether the check targets UI privilege modal warnings (Finance/Minfin catalog) or API tariff calculation delta (iBPM/EWA) before planning.
expectations: Surfaces the distinction between UI modal validation and API discount/privilege calculation
Crystallizes requirements into the Dual-Plan header once the user answers

evals.prompt: Запусти тест tests/finance/osago/pages/catalog.finance.ts за допомогою npx playwright test і покажи результат.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an unambiguous direct execution command, executing the test via playwright-cli without asking redundant clarifying questions.
expectations: Recognizes that direct execution commands with explicit file path and parameters have zero ambiguity
Refrains from asking redundant interview questions when parameters are fully specified
Routes or triggers test execution directly via playwright-cli
